readerCopy.body: Being responsible for something can make leaving it feel wrong long after the arrangement has stopped being useful. When Saturn opposes the North Node, the strongest argument for staying may be duty: the role you know how to perform, the promise you made, the institution that relies on you, or the commitment that has already taken years of work. You may still need to finish what you promised or protect people who depend on you. Separate that responsibility from the assumption that keeping your word requires preserving the entire setup exactly as it is.
